title: Governo abre casa brasileira para incubar startups em Lisboa (Startups.com.br, 12 November 2025)
what_it_says: Startups.com.br reports that ApexBrasil and Sebrae named ten startups at Web Summit 2025 for a nine-month incubation in a historic Lisbon building shared with Embratur and Fiocruz, chosen from 112 exhibitors with Plug and Play.
